training_selection: Highest exact-fidelity two-layer fit among the three completed starts for training case r1; no choice based on new cost or hardware outcomes.
new_cost_generation: Original independent cost generators with new seeds. Constraints, qubit interpretation, native topology, layer count, annealing schedule, and penalty/normalization rules are held fixed.
fit_selection: Warm and cold methods each receive three starts capped at 40 objective/gradient evaluations, including their initial evaluation. Select each method by highest final exact-source fidelity, then start index. The historical fitting cost of warm parameters is reported separately.
hardware_selection: No hardware screening or outcome-dependent selection. Execute unchanged training parameters, selected warm-adapted parameters, and selected cold-fit parameters on the same inherited physical patch.
primary_inference: 36 jointly Holm-adjusted two-sided block-conditional contrasts: six cases, feasible/within-5-percent/optimal events, and warm versus cold/reuse. Shot uncertainty pertains to this acquisition, not population generalization.
scope: Small numerical and hardware pilot of parameter adaptation; original fitting is amortized across new costs. Candidate reuse of existing samples is a separate secondary analysis. Near-identical source targets and unchanged parameters are explicit controls. No extrapolation to scaling or computational advantage.
